section_summary.extract_value: This section reports that the final dataset comprised 249 college women from a regional campus of a large Midwestern U.S. university (ages 18–28, M = 19.1). The sample was predominantly White (86.3%) and consisted of undergraduates (majority first-year); no measures or statistics for BMI or body appreciation (BAS/BAS-2) or correlations between them are reported here.
